authority_if_any_v7_gate_fails.required_next_action: Freeze the first V7 result. Any changed source-canonical parser, query order, name-key semantics, team equivalence, tiebreak, target selection, source, timeout, retry behavior, gate, or threshold requires a new preregistered version.

query_cascade.name: exact_visible_name
query_cascade.rule: Fill exact source visible_name and press Enter once.

query_cascade.condition: Only if prior response is HTTP 200 parseable players array length 0 and stripping exactly one frozen terminal suffix from visible_name changes the query.
query_cascade.name: terminal_suffix_stripped
query_cascade.rule: Use visible_name with one frozen terminal suffix removed.

query_cascade.condition: Only if every prior executed response is HTTP 200 parseable players array length 0, canonical_data_name parses under the frozen source rule, and canonical name_key differs from visible name_key.
query_cascade.name: source_canonical_name
query_cascade.rule: Query the deterministic source canonical query name exactly once.

query_cascade.condition: Only if every prior executed response is HTTP 200 parseable players array length 0.
query_cascade.name: surname_only
query_cascade.rule: Use the final whitespace-delimited token of suffix-stripped visible_name after trimming punctuation at token edges; require at least 3 alphanumeric characters.

browser_transport.stop_rule: Stop at the first HTTP 200 parseable players array with length > 0. Do not broaden after a nonempty players array even if semantic resolution fails.

conditional_capability_evidence.ari_az_team_alias_qualified_only_if: Every overall V7 gate passes, all four ARI stress targets resolve, and at least one selected ARI target candidate uses NGS teamAbbr AZ.
conditional_capability_evidence.multiple_candidate_tiebreak_qualified_on: Every overall V7 gate passes and at least one target has >1 primary candidate and frozen position+jersey tiebreak resolves exactly one valid GSIS.
conditional_capability_evidence.query_fallback_semantics_qualified_only_: Every overall V7 gate passes and at least one target requires a post-exact query attempt and then resolves uniquely under a frozen semantic name key.
conditional_capability_evidence.source_canonical_name_representation_qua: Every overall V7 gate passes and at least one V7 target executes source_canonical_name after prior empty response(s), then resolves uniquely using the canonical source name key with valid GSIS.

independent_coverage_jersey.denominator: Resolved coverage targets for which tiebreak_applied is false.
independent_coverage_jersey.ngs_value: integer-normalized selected candidate uniformNumber, else jerseyNumber, when nonempty and parseable
independent_coverage_jersey.official_value: integer-normalized target jersey_number when nonempty and parseable

fixed_resolution_rule.candidate_name_match: candidate name_key(displayName) must equal either target name_key(visible_name) or, when available, target name_key(source_canonical_query_name)
fixed_resolution_rule.multiple_candidate_tiebreak: If more than one primary candidate exists, require target jersey_number to parse as integer and target position uppercase to equal candidate position uppercase OR positionGroup uppercase; require candidate jerseyNumber/uniformNumber integer to equal target jersey; keep only candidates satisfying both position and jersey. Resolve only if exactly one remains and its gsisId is valid.
fixed_resolution_rule.single_candidate_rule: If exactly one primary candidate exists and gsisId matches ^00-[0-9]{7}$, resolve it.

official_club_roster_v2.source_native_evidence: Official roster HTML player-name elements expose data-name while the anchor text exposes visible_name; both were captured before NGS V7.

governance.next_phase_after_pass: Freeze and durably preserve V7 before observing any target inactive/availability rows. A separate preregistered point-in-time availability application must distinguish identity, game-day membership, injury designation, inactive status, and replacement/role consequences.

purpose: Prospective out-of-sample validation of a narrowly extended official-roster-to-NGS GSIS resolver on a fresh roster population after V6 failed only the frozen coverage gate. V7 adds one source-native identity representation derived deterministically from the official club roster HTML data-name field (canonical_data_name). It makes no fuzzy, nickname-dictionary, status, outcome, participation, availability, or manual-knowledge repair.

parser.comma_split: Split canonical_data_name on comma; trim each component; discard empty components; require exactly two nonempty components or the canonical representation is unavailable.
parser.component_order: First component is family name; second component is given-name string.
parser.normalization: No nickname table, stemming, token substitution, edit distance, phonetic transform, or manual correction.
parser.suffix_rule: If the final whitespace-delimited token of the given-name string is a frozen suffix token (case-insensitive, optional period for Jr/Sr), move that exact token after the family name; otherwise emit given-name string + space + family name.

source_canonical_name_rule.provenance: Captured directly from official club roster HTML player-name data-name attribute before V7 NGS execution.
source_canonical_name_rule.qualification_ceiling: The canonical representation is a source-native alternate identity string, not independent truth. It can qualify only as a bounded resolver input if V7 overall passes and the rule is empirically exercised successfully.
source_canonical_name_rule.semantic_name_keys: Candidate displayName may match exactly under frozen name_key to either source visible_name or the deterministic source canonical query name when available.

canonical_name_variant_stratum.rule: Take eligible rows whose canonical_data_name parses under the frozen source rule and whose canonical query name has a different frozen name_key from visible_name; sort by selection_key, team, visible_name, profile_path; take first 32.

coverage_stratum.rule: For each team in lexicographic team order, sort eligible rows by selection_key ascending, visible_name ascending, profile_path ascending; take first 2.

source_name_variant_stratum.rule: Take eligible rows whose visible_name matches either frozen source-only regex; sort by selection_key, team, visible_name, profile_path; take first 16.

team_alias_ari_stratum.rule: Sort eligible ARI rows by the same frozen ordering and take first 4.

target_selection.union_rule: Row-identity union of coverage, team_alias_ari, source_name_variant, and canonical_name_variant strata.
